AboutMe.text: I am a Full Stack developer who turns ideas into fast, clear, and intuitive web experiences. I like to build products from scratch, hunt down bugs, and clean up code until every detail falls into place. With over two years of experience, I keep learning, building, and solving problems without sacrificing design or performance.
AboutMe.pros: If production drops dead, I follow the logs, bring it back, and move on; the server can keep the drama.
